specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 Laptop 16GB (TGP-capped slim chassis ~110W)

battery.notes: 90Wh (same chassis). NBC lab WiFi on 2025 GU605CX: 9h00 @150nits; ~5-7h real mixed use, ~1.25h gaming. USB-C PD charging.

price.notes: BBY API 2026-11-24, sku 19965090 (GU606AW-DS98-CA, ASUS Canada direct), $6,999 no sale. 1 review, 5.0/5 (too few to anchor).

offers.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 Gaming Laptop (16" 2.5K OLED Display / Intel Core Ultra 9 386H / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 / 64GB LPDDR5X RAM / 2TB SSD / Windows 11 Home / GU606AW-DS98-CA)

reviews.quote: it's still important to know that it uses a relatively slow version of the GPU... The input devices and speakers remain very good. (NBC 'very good' 90%, 2025 GU605CX RTX 5090/64GB/2TB — nearest tested sibling; no 2026 GU606 pro review retrieved.)

professional.note: No 2026 GU606 pro review found 2026-11-24; inferred from 2025 GU605 line anchor (same chassis/display family) with GPU/CPU deltas.

praises: Top-tier silicon (5080 + 64GB + 2TB) in a 1.87 kg aluminum chassis — the closest thing to a portable workstation that still games
2.5K OLED 240Hz G-Sync panel remains a class leader for gaming; NBC line quote 'fantastic 240 Hz G-Sync OLED display'
Speakers and keyboard/trackpad best-in-class for gaming laptops (NBC line finding)
2x M.2 slots: storage expansion to multiple TB is the easy upgrade the RAM can't get
2026 refresh brings the faster 386H CPU and Wi-Fi 7 as standard
complaints: $6,999 is flagship money for a GPU that NBC proves is TGP-throttled in this chassis — thicker 5080 laptops cost $1.5-2.5k less
Soldered RAM: the 64GB is fixed and priced accordingly; no path beyond
OLED PWM flickering and limited HDR peak brightness persist at $7k where Mini-LED rivals shine brighter
Lid creak / hinge rocking and idle fan pulsation are long-standing line complaints (NBC)
No sale price and no proven review pool yet at BBY — early-adopter pricing on a refresh

design_philosophy: The 2026 high-end expression of the thin-first flagship: maximum GPU this chassis can cool, maximum (soldered) memory, top storage — ASUS's argument that a 1.87 kg OLED machine can double as a creator rig and gaming deck. The TGP tax and price premium are the accepted cost of that philosophy.
rating_notes: Inferred from 2025 GU605 NBC 90% (5090/64GB/2TB tested) per SHARED-zephyrus-g16.md: -1.0 gaming / -1.0 ai_ml for 5080 tier (16 vs 24GB VRAM, both TGP-capped), +0.2 productivity for 386H refresh, -0.2 battery. No 2026 pro review retrieved — disclosed. Upgradability 3.0 (soldered RAM, 2x M.2).
